owner_review.coverage: DF1–DF21 read and derived in full: exact density flux, full-original-observable energy bound, explicit partial-Laplacian potential and force projection, signed collective Gram, positive augmented squared-current matrix, original raw norm floor and exterior Hessian graph. owner_review.strengthening: Uniform O(sqrt(a)) comparison for the original growing observable on I(C), using unchanged bounded energy, replaces the ineffective total-variation-only estimate for this receiver. Exact Poisson potential is (Delta_e w+2T_e)/(6b). The new projected squared-current trial removes a strictly positive finite force-curl cost on each nonempty proper patch; at least two of the original three shifts have strictly positive finite gains for all sufficiently large regulators.
owner_review.correction: Projected columns may be dependent; retaining z² times the original complementary norm proves an invertible matrix without assuming projected independence. Physical amplitude uses the actual projected norm, and the complementary penalty is explicitly subtracted from the augmented residual. No uniform-gap inverse estimate is used.
owner_review.limitations: No asymptotic size assigned to the strict finite gains or remaining collective signed moments. The complete window bound is proved, but no positive original shrinking-window value is assigned. Interacting continuum construction, reconstruction, theory identification and global smooth no-gap endpoint remain active.
